h1.en: 66 kW stays on the Diesel 40 vs Diesel 50 Concrete Pump page
h1.zh: 66 kW仍写在柴油40和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, distance 120 m / 360 m and Kawasaki 112. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine).
directAnswer.zh: 柴油40和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m、川崎112。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine)。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine). The image subject is Automobile starter. Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Neither specification table lists an aggregate-size row. Pumping distance (H / V): Diesel 40 lists 120 m / 360 m. Diesel 50 lists 150 m / 450 m. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine)。画面内容是Automobile starter。柴油40和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。理论输送量：柴油40标出 26 m³/h；柴油50标出 30 m³/h。外形尺寸：柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm；柴油50标出 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/，看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, distance 120 m / 360 m and Kawasaki 112. Diesel engine power: Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW. Diesel 50 lists 6105 / 99 kW. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 40 lists Kawasaki 112. Diesel 50 lists Kawasaki 140. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Do not invent an aggregate size for either page from a neighbouring diesel row. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m、川崎112。最大出口压力：柴油40标出 25 MPa；柴油50标出 30 MPa。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Diesel 50 lists 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, distance 150 m / 450 m and Kawasaki 140. Theoretical output: Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h. Dimensions: Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Diesel 50 lists 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Both pages use the same set of labels. Open /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40 and /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50.
body.zh: 柴油50标出 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、距离 150 m / 450 m、川崎140。输送距离（水平/垂直）：柴油40标出 120 m / 360 m；柴油50标出 150 m / 450 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Both list a 0.4 m³ hopper. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. Diesel 50 lists 30 MPa. The same shown value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Where the values differ, keep the value on the page you opened. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW；柴油50标出 6105 / 99 kW。液压泵：柴油40标出 Kawasaki 112；柴油50标出 Kawasaki 140。不要用相邻柴油泵的骨料行，给这两页编一个粒径。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 list the same diesel engine power as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW. Diesel 50 lists 6105 / 99 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine).
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW。柴油50标出 6105 / 99 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine).
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40标出 26 m³/h。柴油50标出 30 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 list the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. Diesel 50 lists 30 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine).
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40标出 25 MPa。柴油50标出 30 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can I treat Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 as one concrete pump?
question.zh: 可以把柴油40和柴油50当成同一台混凝土泵吗？

answer.en: No. They are separate pages from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Match power, output, pressure and distance on the page you intend to order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine).
answer.zh: 不能。它们是河北品锦机械在邢台的两个页面。要按下单的那一页核对功率、产量、压力和距离。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starter_(engine)画面里印出的数字。
